comment: Harness allowlist. Agent 365 does not read this file. Default deny: a tool that is not listed does not run. requires_approval is refused unless the caller passes an approval decision for that invocation. allowed false without requires_approval cannot be approved.

send_external_email.comment: Outbound mail leaves the tenant and cannot be unsent. A human approves each use, or the tool stays off.
